Message:
As soon as Guinevere
caught sight of me,
she pulled me into a tight hug.

“Hey, don’t treat me
like some little kid!”

“Hehe, sorry...
I’m just so happy,
I couldn’t help it...!”

In the warmth of her embrace,
I could feel it clearly.

The happiness she felt...
at having the friend
she thought she’d lost...
by her side once more—

Let’s call the others over
and have some tea together!”

“...Tea, you say?
Hm, once I’ve
finished my training,
I’ll consider it.”

Before, I probably would have
gotten mad and said,
“You aren’t taking our mission
seriously enough!”
But—

“You’re so dependable,
always working
so hard like that.
What a good girl you are!
You get...a gold star!”

“Honestly...!
I told you not to treat me
like some little kid!”

Right now,
I want to treasure the time
I have with everyone...
That’s how I felt...
